proposed.text: Under SPP 204-A, in how many arrangements can fulltime supervision services be provided?

options.text: Two: dual capacity (architect as supervisor) or consulting architect only
Three: CSG, architect, or construction manager
Four: CSG, architect, contractor's superintendent, or independent inspector

rationale.a: CSG-only is just one of the two recognized arrangements.
rationale.b: Correct. SPP 204-A recognizes two arrangements: (1) dual capacity, where the architect of record also provides fulltime supervision, and (2) consulting architect only, where a separate architect/firm provides supervision services.
rationale.c: Three arrangements overspecifies. Construction management is covered under SPP 204-B.
rationale.d: Four arrangements is incorrect and mixes roles from different SPP documents.
rationale.correct: SPP 204-A provides for two arrangements: dual capacity (where the designing architect also supervises) and consulting architect only (where a separate professional provides supervision). Both require qualified CSG personnel.
rationale.takeaway: Two arrangements: dual capacity or consulting architect only.
